messages.content: Before I file the August trip, I want a clean hotel comparison using full costs. Please include taxes, breakfast, and the local transportation each choice creates for all four nights. Also verify the deposit rules, cancellation deadlines, and whether I can leave my suitcase on Wednesday in New York.

I’ll normalize both cities around the confirmed schedule: New York Monday and Tuesday nights, the 6:03 p.m. Wednesday train from Moynihan, Boston Wednesday and Thursday nights, and the 5:18 p.m. Friday flight home. Are you traveling alone for both hotel stays?
Yes, one adult and one room throughout.

For New York, the Moore in Chelsea is $742 including taxes for two nights. Breakfast is not included; allowing $18 each morning adds $36. From Newark, the estimated train and subway cost is $18.40, and the hotel is close enough to your Chelsea and Flatiron meetings that no paid local trip is necessary. On Wednesday, a taxi from the Moore to Moynihan should be about $18 including tip. The practical total is therefore about $814.40.
And the cheaper New York property?

The Arlo Midtown is $668 including taxes for the same two nights. Breakfast is separate; using the same $36 allowance brings it to $704. Newark transit is also about $18.40. You would likely spend about $22 getting to the Wednesday meeting area with your schedule, but the hotel is near Moynihan, so no taxi would be needed before the train. Its normalized total is about $744.40, roughly $70 less than the Moore.
That makes the cheaper one sound fairly reasonable. What is the luggage issue?

Arlo will hold luggage after checkout, but you would need to return west after your final meeting to collect it. Based on the meeting ending around 4:35 p.m., that adds a cross-town trip during the afternoon rush and leaves little margin before the 5:30 p.m. station target. At the Moore, you can collect the suitcase near the meeting area and go directly to Moynihan. The higher cost buys a simpler Wednesday sequence.
Please confirm that the Moore will actually hold the bag, not just that it usually does.

The reservation record now includes written confirmation from the front desk that one suitcase may be stored after the 11:00 a.m. Wednesday checkout and collected by 5:00 p.m. There is no charge. The room requires a card guarantee, not an advance room deposit. A temporary incidentals authorization of $100 is taken at check-in and released after departure.
What is the exact cancellation cutoff there?
The Moore remains refundable until 6:00 p.m. Eastern time on Saturday, August 1. Cancelling after that point results in a charge of one night plus tax. The current $742 total has not changed.
Keep the Moore, then. Now normalize Boston the same way.

The conference hotel is $756 including taxes for Wednesday and Thursday nights and includes breakfast Thursday and Friday. It is a short walk from Thursday’s Back Bay program, with an estimated $14 taxi from South Station after the train and about $31 to Logan on Friday. Its normalized total is $801. The conference rate requires full prepayment and is nonrefundable once booked.
Compare that with the Park Plaza booking.

Hilton Boston Park Plaza is $704 including taxes. Breakfast is not included; budgeting $24 per morning adds $48. A taxi from South Station should be about $15, Thursday’s program is walkable, and Friday transportation to Logan is approximately $31. That produces a normalized total of $798. The difference is only $3, but Park Plaza preserves cancellation flexibility.
Does Park Plaza take a deposit, and is the late arrival protected? The train does not arrive until 9:49.

No advance room deposit is charged on this rate; a card guarantees the booking. At check-in, the hotel may authorize room, tax, and $75 per night for incidentals. The reservation is marked for arrival after 10:30 p.m., and the hotel has confirmed it will not release the room as a no-show before midnight. Your estimated arrival is 10:10 to 10:25 p.m.
And the cancellation deadline? Also verify the Friday bag hold, since I have lunch before the airport.

Cancellation is free until 6:00 p.m. Eastern time on Tuesday, August 4. After that, the penalty is one night plus tax. The bell desk has confirmed complimentary storage for one suitcase after Friday checkout, with collection around 1:45 p.m. noted. That supports leaving for Logan at about 2:05 p.m.
Keep Park Plaza. Please make sure neither hotel choice has accidentally added breakfast to the booking.

Confirmed: neither reservation includes a breakfast package. The Moore remains $742 including taxes, and Park Plaza remains $704 including taxes. Breakfast is an out-of-pocket planning allowance only: $36 in New York and $48 in Boston.
Good. Give me the completed itinerary with the real booked total first, then the trip estimate including breakfast and local transportation.

Completed itinerary: Monday, August 3, United nonstop Denver to Newark departs 3:05 p.m. and arrives 8:46 p.m. under H7M2LK. Take rail and subway to Chelsea, estimated at $18.40, and stay solo at the Moore Monday and Tuesday under MCH-80371 for $742 including taxes. Breakfast is not included. The hotel will store one suitcase after Wednesday’s 11:00 a.m. checkout; retrieve it by 5:00 p.m., then take an estimated $18 taxi to Moynihan. The 6:03 p.m. Acela departs under 48A921 and arrives Boston South Station at 9:49 p.m. for $126. Take an estimated $15 taxi to Hilton Boston Park Plaza, where Wednesday and Thursday nights are confirmed under HBP-84726 for $704 including taxes. Late arrival is protected; breakfast is not included. On Friday, leave the suitcase with the bell desk after checkout, attend lunch near the Public Garden, collect the bag around 1:45 p.m., and leave about 2:05 p.m. for Logan; estimated taxi cost is $31. United departs Boston nonstop at 5:18 p.m. and arrives Denver at 7:52 p.m. under H7M2LK. The booked air, rail, and hotel total remains $2,184. Adding $84 for four breakfasts and $82.40 for the identified local transportation gives a working trip estimate of $2,350.40. The Moore is refundable until 6:00 p.m. Eastern August 1; Park Plaza is refundable until 6:00 p.m. Eastern August 4.
